QuestInfo.name: [Advice from Dr. Pepper] A Sincere Expression
QuestInfo.0: You'll need to win the trust of the people to pass the M-Forcer Action Exam! Talk to Dr. Pepper to learn how to leave a good impression on others. She's the expert, after all.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Pepper says you'll need a Sincere Expression. Defeat monsters to get self-help books to learn all about it. You'll need to hunt monsters #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you#k to find the self-help books.\n\n #rTip: This quest is repeatable if you lose your Sincere Expression.
QuestInfo.2: You're received a Sincere Expression from Dr. Pepper!

0.0: If you want to be an M-Forcer, you have to win the trust of the people, right? Take me. My potions are delicious, so everyone adores me. Anyway, you'll need a Sincere Expression to earn people's trust.
0.1: You know what? I'm too busy taste-testing my own potions... hiccup... to help you figure this out. Go read a self-help book. Browsing through 10 copies of #bA Better You: Becoming a Morning Person#k should help you learn all about faking, I mean, having a Sincere Expression.

yes.0: You can get the self-help book by hunting monsters. Just don't bother with any that are #bover 21 levels above or 11 levels under you.#k They're 'too good' to need to improve themselves.

no.0: I see how it is. Think you're better than the rest of us? NO POTIONS FOR YOU... hiccup!

1.0: Did you read the books? Sorry if I'm not paying attention. I had to make up a whole new batch of potions because I drank all of my last batch... hiccup!

item.0: You can get the self-help book by hunting monsters. Just don't bother with any that are #bover 21 levels above you.#k They're 'too good' to need to improve themselves.
